name: Virginia

period.description: If you do not get long-term care, your spenddown runs for six months; coverage starts the day your bills reach the amount and lasts until the six months end.

submission.description: Send proof of your medical bills to your local Department of Social Services. Bills should show what insurance paid and what you still owe.

notes: Health insurance premiums, including Medicare premiums, count toward the spenddown.
Paid bills count only if the care was during your six-month period. Old bills you still owe can count.
Medicaid will not pay bills from before the day you met your spenddown.
At the end of the six months, you must apply again to be checked for a new period.
